subject.title: Subagent lifecycle observability + async supervision controls

question: Which durable contract should own subagent lifecycle receipts and audited cancel/steer/resume supervision: extend the metadata-only audit ledger, add a subagent-specific lifecycle ledger, or defer until the durable coordination/runtime design is accepted?
rationale: Current main has building blocks but lacks the requested ordered lifecycle and public supervision API, and the owner choice affects persistence, redaction, authorization, retention, idempotency, and avoiding duplicate audit sources.

options.title: Extend Shared Audit
options.body: Add subagent lifecycle and supervision event kinds to the shared metadata-only audit foundation so operators have one audit source of truth.

options.title: Create Subagent Ledger
options.body: Add a subagent-specific lifecycle table/API if maintainers need a richer schema than generic audit can safely represent.

options.title: Defer To Coordination Design
options.body: Keep this issue open but pause implementation until the durable coordination/runtime design settles the supervision model.

recommendation.title: Extend Shared Audit
recommendation.body: Add subagent lifecycle and supervision event kinds to the shared metadata-only audit foundation so operators have one audit source of truth.

likelyOwner.reason: They own the most recent adjacent audit foundation that this request would likely extend.
